decisions.sample: one small sub-directory per major language family (Ruby, TypeScript, Erlang, Go, Zig) so indexing completes in seconds per entry — the proof is the search contract + freshness truthfulness, not exhaustive coverage
decisions.freshness: after indexing, one real file is modified; symbols from that file must be flagged stale on the next search — a stale result presented as fresh is a recorded failure
decisions.failures: every probe is a harness check; failures land in the evidence, nothing is excluded

limitations: Only a small sub-directory per repo is indexed (full 29-repo indexing is hours-long); broader coverage is M14.
A sub-directory with no resolvable symbol is skipped (recorded, not failed).
